name: dev-skills
description: Development skills for Rust and frontend work: code review, review-wave orchestration, and commit scripting.

plugins.name: code-review-rust
plugins.description: Review Rust for idioms, security, complexity, duplication, test quality, and NATS patterns.

plugins.name: code-review-web
plugins.description: Review React/TypeScript (Vite) frontends for hooks, types, async, a11y, security, and tests.

plugins.name: code-review-triage
plugins.description: Group triaged backlog findings into semantic review waves with a recorded file scope per wave.

plugins.name: code-review-run-wave
plugins.description: Run one planned review wave in an isolated git worktree: apply fixes, QA, merge, close.

plugins.name: code-review-run-waves
plugins.description: Run every open review wave concurrently, one worktree each, landing merges via a shared lock.

plugins.name: commit-script
plugins.description: Generate a script that stages grouped files into conventional commits, optionally ending in a pull request.

plugins.name: rust-meta
plugins.description: Process external Rust content and integrate new knowledge into code-review-rust.
